Mandatory Stats: Make sure to fill out your resist, you want 75% fire/cold/lightning resist. Chaos resist is good, but not mandatory to have 75%, I usually aim for 30-50%. You'll also most likely need 1-2 attribute rolls on gear, belt will solve strength and if you need intelligence, get it on a ring or amulet.

Hybrid swap: You want the highest Energy shield helmet you can afford and a very high evasion chest to make Ghost Dance effective, as it's your only way to recover ES. I would also try to get good hybrid boots. You'll probably need intelligence on helmet to have enough attributes.

Rings/glove: try to focus on high flat damage to attacks, preferable cold/phys.

Bow: When swapping to crit, you want a high crit bow, preferable with t3 %crit or higher. (3% or more). After that, get the highest dps you can afford or craft.

Quiver: You preferable want a crit quiver on the Visceral Quiver base. You'll want both crit hit chance and crit damage. Good prefixes are bow damage/proj speed/cold damage to attack/phys damage to attacks. Cadiro's Gambit is also a really good quiver and highly worth getting once you can afford it (I would only use this quiver if you're crit).

amulet: Preferable want +proj levels. Crit chance/crit damage is also good, once you swap to crit. Attributes/resist are also fine here. You need at least 45 spirit on the amulet to use all spirit gems. Crit on amulet is also strong, but might be expensive with spirit and +3 proj.

Helmet: It's very important to have a high ES helmet because of Subterfuge Mask.

Chest: you want the highest evasion chest you can afford, this is very important for defense, specially when combined with Beastial Skin on the passive tree. use Greater Iron Rune

Boots: You want the highest movement speed boots you can afford, it's a very important stat. Besides that look for high life/resistance.

Belt: Not a lot of choices here, just Life/str/resist, eventually you want to get a Headhunter.

Rarity: Still really good in 0.5, I would try to hit at least 100% if you want to farm efficiently (don't focus on this if you feel like you're lacking damage or defense)

Jewels on tree: Just looking for generic damage: attack damage, elemental damage, movement speed, bonus from quivers, projectile damage, attack speed, crit chance, crit damage, etc.
Eventually you'll also want Heart of the Well with double "gain as extra" and Against the Darkness with double again as extra as well.

important:
You'll want 1 sapphire jewel with mana on kill to sustain mana during mapping. For bosses, having Mark of Siphoning II on Freezing Mark with Eternal Mark should give you enough sustain.

Anoint: Climate Change or Beastial Skin for defense
Serrated Edges is always a cheap option.

---Mana Issues
There's a few things you can do here to help out your mana sustain and I'll list them all here.
Reminder: Always run one jewel with 2% mana on kill.

1) Run a regular mana flask with increased recovery and just use your mana flask button, this along with a 2% mana on kill jewel will easily sustain you
2) Take Conservative Casting for 3 passives points.
3) Drop Wind Dancer for Mana Remnants (use Harmonic Remnants II, Remnant Potency III and Khatal's Rejuvenation - For khatal you either need Dialla's Desire as well or 1 point into herald reservation

To pick up a draggable item, press the space bar. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move the item. Press space again to drop the item in its new position, or press escape to cancel.
Gem Priority
+26
+40

The links are in priority, so takeout the the last gem if you don't have a 6 link in that skill.

6 Link Priority: Snipe -> Ice Shot -> Herald of Ice
Quality Priority: Freezing Mark -> Herald of Ice -> Snipe -> Ice Shot

Keep in mind you don't need Fork on Ice Shot when doing pinnacle bosses, a good swap is Cold Attunement or Freeze.

Don't use Elemental Armament III, only level 2.

You want 145 spirit to run all spirit gems (ghost dance is 25 spirit at 20% quality).
To run Khatal's Rejuvenation You need Dialla's Desire(if you don't have, than drop Khatal's).
Ghost Dance needs 20% quality

On pinnacle bosses swap your Rakiata's Flow into Snipe (drop Elemental Armament II)
Garukhan's Resolve is also very strong, if you have it replace Inexorable Critical I on Snipe.

If your character is geared, you can also just spam Ice Shot on bosses and instantly kill them without snipe, just make sure to keep your Tornado Shot up.

Boss rotation:
The goal is to freeze the boss into a Barrage Snipe combo.

Pre-place Tornado Shot, spam Ice Shot until the boss is frozen. Use Barrage into Snipe. Make sure you still have a Tornado Shot down before casting barrage/snipe.

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and Freezing Mark on weapon set 2.

Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything, after 161 dex you should default to strength for more HP.

Once you have Rakiata's Flow you can takeout Snowpiercer and instead take Beastial Skin for more defense.

This is a level 94 tree. Takeout some Evasion/energy shield hybrid nodes if you're lower lvl.

If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take Feathered Fletching

Beastial Skin is a very solid evasion node if you want higher evasion (can also anoint this).

Ascendancy order:
Projectile Proximity Specialisation(point blank) -> Endless Munitions -> Gathering Winds -> Mirage Deadeye

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and Freezing Mark on weapon set 2.
